title: OpenMake LLM: Local-first AI workspace for your models and tools | Product Hunt
excerpt: Open-source, self-hosted AI workspace for local and open-weight models. Route vLLM/LiteLLM, run autonomous agents in persistent Docker sandboxes, connect MCP tools, do cited Deep Research, create exportable artifacts, and enable external models only with your own keys.
